verdict.rationale: Bias reduction is a fair question for an ATS, but the evidence pack never mentions structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review, or DEI/diversity funnel reporting. The general analytics dashboards (lever-docs-13) and AI-generated interview questions (lever-docs-27) are adjacent features, not documented bias-reduction capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the platform helps reduce bias — structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review options, and DEI reporting on the funnel
